# Key Findings (auto-generated)

Factual rollup of the current feature dataset. Interpretation lives in the final report.

## Overview
- Posts: 54,244 across 2 platforms (youtube: 46,913, instagram: 7,331).
- Content date range: 2016-04-20 to 2026-10-04.

## Sentiment by platform (English)
- instagram: positive 85.1%, neutral 7.7%, negative 7.3%.
- youtube: positive 61.7%, neutral 21.6%, negative 16.7%.

## Engagement vs sentiment
- Avg engagement percentile by sentiment: negative 0.488, neutral 0.497, positive 0.505 (spread 0.017).
- Relationship is essentially flat (sentiment does not predict engagement).

## Dominant topics (by volume)
- T4: agent, think, real, does - 25,696 posts.
- T0: business, help, right, digitalmarketing - 5,747 posts.
- T10: easy, understand, easy understand, tutorial - 3,010 posts.
- T7: time, long, real time, waste - 2,146 posts.
- T9: rich, broke, dumb, broke dumb - 1,826 posts.

- Rising: T10: easy, understand, easy understand, tutorial (+1.38 pts).

- Declining: T3: course, hi, step, pls (-0.87 pts).
- Declining: T0: business, help, right, digitalmarketing (-4.29 pts).

## Models
- Production sentiment model: vader (deploy-domain macro-F1 0.6493).
- Topic model: NMF, k=12, UMass coherence -0.842 (more coherent than LDA).
